candidates.change_summary: Change the block assignment from block.number + 1 to block.number + 2, altering when settle becomes callable.
Remove the require(msg.value == 1 ether) check, allowing lockInGuess to be called without sending 1 ether.
Remove the require(guesses[msg.sender].block == 0) check, allowing a user to overwrite a pending guess.
Change transfer amount from 2 ether to 0 ether in settle()
Delete the require that block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block
Replace blockhash(guesses[msg.sender].block) with blockhash(block.number) in settle()
Remove the condition 'answer != 0' from the if statement in settle()
Replace 'guesses[msg.sender].guess == answer' with 'guesses[msg.sender].guess != answer' in settle()
Replace 'block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block' with 'block.number >= guesses[msg.sender].block' in settle()
